title: Beetlejuice! Beetlejuice! Beetlejuice!
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine all the ingredients in a highball over ice, stir, then garnish.

Strawberry Syrup1 cup granulated sugar
1 cup strawberries (tops removed and cut in half)
1 cup water
Heat all the ingredients in saucepan until the sugar is dissolved. Allow to cool, then strain into a bottle and refrigerate.
